_comment: Three monthly headline sentiment prints used as OBR growth-input proxies. Each slot records its own reference month and publication date. The fixture-level observed_at is the oldest slot, so the 40-day freshness guard catches an omitted monthly release. Values are the published final S&P UK Services PMI, GfK Consumer Confidence Barometer headline, and RICS house-price net balance. Refresh after each release and add the corresponding history point before backfilling.

services_pmi.source: S&P Global UK Services PMI, September 2026 final (52.1, down from August final 52.5). Source release: https://www.pmi.spglobal.com/Public/Home/PressRelease/23453dfdab0048ee8a69994752851579

consumer_confidence.source: GfK Consumer Confidence Barometer powered by NIM, October 2026 overall index -24 (down 11 points). Source release: https://nielseniq.com/global/en/news-center/2026/consumer-confidence-plunges-11-points-to-24-in-october/

rics_price_balance.source: RICS UK Residential Market Survey, September 2026 headline house-price net balance -32% (August -28%). Source survey: https://www.rics.org/content/dam/ricsglobal/documents/market-surveys/RICS-UK-Residential-Market-Survey_September-2026.pdf
